video_title: Drake Waited for Jayson Tatum: ‘Go On Without Me’

quotes.speaker: Jayson Tatum
quotes.summary_phrase: Jayson Tatum reflects on entering his tenth NBA season
quotes.excerpt: It is crazy to think I am just into my tenth year. In real life I am still young.
quotes.quote: It is been good. The season just started, so it is crazy to think I am just into my tenth year. In real life I am still young, but in the league I am getting a little old, so I am just trying to stay present, stay young.

quotes.speaker: Jayson Tatum
quotes.summary_phrase: Jayson Tatum on mentoring younger players in the league
quotes.excerpt: We had two rookies come in and one of the rookies was at my first elite camp.
quotes.quote: We had two rookies come in and one of the rookies was at my first elite camp a couple years back. And then our rookie, the other guy, he was born in 2007. And I am like, damn, I feel old. I was in fourth grade in 2007.

quotes.speaker: Jayson Tatum
quotes.summary_phrase: Jayson Tatum on changing his diet and recovery habits
quotes.excerpt: I used to eat Popeyes before the game when I was in my first year.
quotes.quote: I used to eat Popeyes before the game when I was in my first year. That is over. I definitely cannot do that no more. So, you know, transitioning into getting more sleep and recovery and lifting a lot more, things like that, just to get the body right.

quotes.speaker: Jayson Tatum
quotes.summary_phrase: Jayson Tatum on his father's influence on his basketball career
quotes.excerpt: My dad, he played college basketball, Saint Louis University, and he played overseas for a little bit.
quotes.quote: My dad, he played college basketball, Saint Louis University, and he played overseas for a little bit. So he was the one who kind of introduced me to the game and taught me how to play when I was really young.

quotes.speaker: Jayson Tatum
quotes.summary_phrase: Jayson Tatum on his early realization of basketball competition
quotes.excerpt: I remember we went to Nationals in New Orleans, fourth grade, and I thought I was the best.
quotes.quote: I remember we went to Nationals in New Orleans, fourth grade, and I thought I was the best ten-year-old in the country. And then I went to go see other players and I remember we played this team called Cal Supreme, and I seen what the best ten-year-olds in the country look like. And that was a reality check for me and I remember I was like, oh shit, I am not as good as I thought I was.

quotes.speaker: Jayson Tatum
quotes.summary_phrase: Jayson Tatum on his high school rival Seventh Woods
quotes.excerpt: I remember my freshman year, it was a kid named Seventh Woods. We were the same class.
quotes.quote: I remember my freshman year, it was a kid named Seventh Woods. We were the same class and I was like, damn. I could not even dream about doing some of the shit he doing. And part of it is just like, maybe he peaked when we were younger, right? And I acknowledge I am 6'9", he is only 6'2", 6'3". Basketball is how tall you are, it definitely helps. But I remember being 14 and seeing his mixtape and I was like, he is definitely going to the league.

quotes.speaker: Jayson Tatum
quotes.summary_phrase: Jayson Tatum on his high school ranking and Harry Giles
quotes.excerpt: I probably would have been number two. Harry Giles was ranked ahead of me.
quotes.quote: I probably would have been number two. Harry Giles was ranked ahead of me. He was tough in high school. And actually, one of my best friends even to this day, we chose to go to Duke together. But AG was at that time, he was for sure, he was the best player in high school. And his did not -- he played in the league for a little bit. And his was not a lack of motivation or work ethic, his was, you know, he tore both his ACLs. Just could not, you know, get past that part, which is unfortunate.

quotes.speaker: Jayson Tatum
quotes.summary_phrase: Jayson Tatum on his experience during the NBA Draft
quotes.excerpt: The draft process was two months from when I declared to that night.
quotes.quote: The draft process was two months from when I declared to that night. And at that point, I did not really care where I went. I was like, I am ready to like have a team and call somewhere home. So I just remember we all get off the bus, we take the photo on stage and we all sit at our tables and it was just one of those surreal moments like, man, I dreamed about this day literally since I could remember. I got drafted at 19, I have been playing basketball since I was four. So for that stretch I used to dream of what draft day would be like. And I remember when Adam Silver would come out, right before he would say a name, all the cameras would run to a table. So the third pick came out, all the cameras ran to my table. I am like, oh shit. But then they left and they went to Josh Jackson's table. And I am like, damn. And then it was like right before he said it, they all came back to my table and then they said my name. It was like the weight of the world had been lifted off my shoulders.

quotes.speaker: Jayson Tatum
quotes.summary_phrase: Jayson Tatum on his long-term dedication to basketball
quotes.excerpt: I had one dream and one goal at five years old to get drafted playing the NBA.
quotes.quote: I had one dream and one goal at five years old to get drafted playing the NBA. So in my mind, I worked towards that goal every single day for 14 years. And if you try to translate that, it is like, how many people do you know will work at something for 14 years until it happened? And it is like try to imagine every single day working towards something for 14 years and and finally it came true.

quotes.speaker: Jayson Tatum
quotes.summary_phrase: Jayson Tatum on the high level of competition in the NBA
quotes.excerpt: Everybody was better than I thought they were, like individually.
quotes.quote: Everybody was better than I thought they were, like individually. And you hear people all the time talk about the the 15th guy on the bench is like unbelievably good. And like when I was younger, you know, I only thought about the stars. And I when I got to the league, I am like, oh shit, no, everybody can play, which means that the best players are are that good because these guys that don't really get to play are still professionals, they are still in the NBA for a reason.

quotes.speaker: Jayson Tatum
quotes.summary_phrase: Jayson Tatum on the realization that winning a championship is not the end
quotes.excerpt: You win a championship and it is like, still got to wake up the next day.
quotes.quote: So what I realized about winning a championship was, I mean, I I realize a lot of things. It was just, you know, my my rookie year we went to the conference finals, we played Bron and them in a game seven to go to the championship. So by the time I won a champion like got to the finals the second time, I had been in the conference finals five times, I had been to the finals in 2022 and lost. It got to a point where it was like this narrative of like, oh, they, you know, it can't win, it can't do it. And I found myself trying to like using that as motivation to prove people wrong. And then, you know, I then won the championship and I I realized in that moment that like, oh, this wasn't about proving everybody else wrong. Because that's never going to stop. There is, oh, they won one, they can't do it again and and so it's like I realized in that moment like, oh, that shit is like none of this is real. Like that does not that doesn't matter. It was more so about that moment was about the people that believed in myself and us and as a team, those that kind of stuck by us throughout year after year after year. Like it was about that circle and that group.

quotes.speaker: Jayson Tatum
quotes.summary_phrase: Jayson Tatum on the reality of winning an NBA championship
quotes.excerpt: You win a championship and it is like, still got to wake up the next day.
quotes.quote: You win a championship and it is like, still got to wake up the next day, right? You still got to get ready for the next season. Like it is like kind of like life goes on and it is like, oh, this was definitely cool, like that shit was fun, but I don't know, it is just tomorrow came and you got to try to do it again.

quotes.speaker: Jayson Tatum
quotes.summary_phrase: Jayson Tatum on the frustration of being a DNP
quotes.excerpt: I was confused. I was confused for sure, and you know, it was frustrating, right?
quotes.quote: I was confused. I was confused for sure, and you know, it was frustrating, right? Just as a competitor, you know, being on the team, and obviously, right, the other 11 best players in the country and, um, feeling like I could be out there and and want to help and and and be a part of, you know, what we trying to accomplish. Uh, and it was tough, right? I just, I just wanted to win the finals, I was all-NBA first team, I was on the cover of 2K, like I was having a crazy, crazy summer. And then to get to the Olympics and then that happened, and I don't know, man, it was just, it was hard to process, right?

quotes.speaker: Jayson Tatum
quotes.summary_phrase: Jayson Tatum on Steve Kerr's communication during the Olympics
quotes.excerpt: Steve like, he came to me before we got on a bus to go to the game.
quotes.quote: Steve like, he came to me before we got on a bus to go to the game because I remember KD was he was he was out for some of like the exhibition games and early rounds. Yeah, and then he he came back. And I remember Steve was like, you know, Kevin's back, so we going to have to try to figure some out with the lineup. He was like, but just be patient. I was like, fuck does that mean? Like why you telling me that? And then I remember sitting on the bench and I think it was like once once I didn't get in the first quarter, I was like, oh, some fishy shit going on. That's when it kind of hit me like, oh, that's what he was trying to tell me without.

quotes.speaker: Jayson Tatum
quotes.summary_phrase: Jayson Tatum on his Achilles injury recovery
quotes.excerpt: It was like different phases of an emotional rollercoaster, right?
quotes.quote: It was like different phases of an emotional rollercoaster, right? Um, because like I said, I just we just won the championship, got our whole team back essentially, so in my mind I am like, man, we going to do it again. Had an incredible regular season. Excuse me, the All-NBA first team again, right? We we just won the first round 4-1, so now playing against the Knicks and I just remember we was down 2-1, but this was game four and I am just uh I just felt really good about the day. I am like, man, this like this is what basketball is about, like we down 2-1, it's New York, the environment is going to be incredible, like me and my teammates we going to come in here and we going to steal another game and we going to go back home. And I just I just remember being ready to compete, like ready to hoop. Um, and you know, any any athlete, especially basketball player, like they know like I was just in the zone, I had had like 44 points, like I was just in the crazy rhythm and then that shit just like just happened, right? Something I never thought was ever going to happen, especially to me. And then a snap of a finger it's like, oh, everything that I thought was about to happen, now I got to, you know, plan and prepare for something else.

quotes.speaker: Jayson Tatum
quotes.summary_phrase: Jayson Tatum on the mental challenge of his injury
quotes.excerpt: I think initially for me it took me like three weeks to accept that this like happened.
quotes.quote: I think initially for me it took me like three weeks to accept that this like happened to me. I used to wake up in the middle of the night like it was a nightmare and I look at my foot and I got this big ass boot on and I just lay back and be like, what the fuck? But things started to get better for me from a mental standpoint once I just accepted like, you know what, I can't go back and change what happened. Along side with like, I had to stop thinking about coming back to play basketball. Like it just it seemed it was so far away, like trying to think about coming down the court and dunking on somebody when I look and I can't even walk, like it is just it is just too far. So for me, accepting that it happened to me and it sounds cliché, but I used to I would just wake up and be like, man, when I used to go to rehab, like try to feel better today than you did yesterday.

quotes.speaker: Jayson Tatum
quotes.summary_phrase: Jayson Tatum on his viral missed free throws in China
quotes.excerpt: I mean, it is a couple things, man. The rim was like 12 feet.
quotes.quote: I mean, it is a couple things, man. The rim was like 12 feet. Oh, that was a 12-foot rim? Okay, so you got. We don't know that on the internet. We just see a hoop, we thinking oh this is a 10-foot hoop. It was like 12-foot rim, jet lag, we just flew in, we flew in from flying from Portland, so it was like 13-hour flight. Ball was different. I am shooting, I am like, I know this shit going to end up on Twitter. But was so fat, I mean, bro, was so fat, same day that was on there. I know. I know. I just tried to play into it. I was like, I know I am missing this one. And you bricked like four more after that. I was like, yo, that was so funny.

quotes.speaker: Jayson Tatum
quotes.summary_phrase: Jayson Tatum on his relationship with Michael Jordan
quotes.excerpt: I got to hang out with him this summer one day. We had lunch for like five, six hours.
quotes.quote: I got to hang out with him this summer one day. We had lunch for like five, six hours. We just like talked about any and everything. And the thing about him is like, he is like he wants, you know, he wants you to reach out and ask him questions or get insight or or things like that. So he is not like it is hard to explain like, he is obviously Michael Jordan. But he is like uh it is cool as somebody as Michael Jordan level could be, like he is that guy. Like he still very much is aware of who he is, but we literally had lunch for like five, six hours and talked about the game today, talked about the game back then, talked about his love for cars and talked about golf. Like it was just like I just was kicking it with my uncle for five, six hours one day and we was just chilling.

quotes.speaker: Jayson Tatum
quotes.summary_phrase: Jayson Tatum on his nicknames
quotes.excerpt: Big Deuce. Big Deuce. Who is Big Deuce? I am Big Deuce.
quotes.quote: Big Deuce. Big Deuce. Who is Big Deuce? I am Big Deuce. So you have your own name tattooed on you? Nickname, one of my nicknames. Okay. Your son is also Deuce. Deuce is now grown up with cameras around him since he was a kid.

quotes.speaker: Jayson Tatum
quotes.summary_phrase: Jayson Tatum on his social media habits
quotes.excerpt: Yeah, I try to I try to stay culturally relevant.
quotes.quote: Yeah, I try to I try to stay culturally relevant. So you know, I am certain that you on TikTok and it is like if you watch one video, then your algorithm is like, oh, he must like videos related to this. And I think Twitter is the same way. And then even right, if you talk about something, we talk about a certain topic and then two days later like I am scrolling on Instagram and whatever we was talking about might pop up.
